title: Console object list: with the view title as the switcher, nothing on screen names the object once the sidebar is collapsed or the list is opened from a link — restore the object crumb (#27594 premise)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ① a premise of a ruled card does not hold on `main`. Filed by the seat from the #27594 dev report (comment 6515207094, open question 1, the dev recommends B). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Business reason

Who: every console reader of an object list.

The #27594 Target 1 (the epic PM, from the maintainer's 2026-10-29 ruling) reads: 「the list title is the view switcher: 「<view label> ▾ · <count>」 … (the object name stays in the breadcrumb and the sidebar highlight)」. On `main`, object list routes draw no breadcrumb (objectui#12461). Once PR #27943 lands, the title names the view ("My Leads ▾"), not the object. With the sidebar collapsed to its icon rail (#27593) or the list opened from a deep link, nothing on the page names the object, except the header icon.

## Mechanism (dev's reading at PR #27943's head `16c25700`)

- The title switcher (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`, new in #27943) reads the open view's label.
- `AppHeader` draws no object crumb on `/apps/APP/OBJECT[/view/VIEW]` since objectui#12461. Measure why #12461 dropped it before restoring: if it was a ruling, this card is `needs_decision`.

## Wanted

The object list routes carry the object crumb (the object's label in the reader's language, linking to the object's default list), as Target 1 of #27594 assumes. The record page's own top-bar breadcrumb is #27524 item 7 and stays there.

## Acceptance

1. On `/apps/APP/OBJECT` and `/apps/APP/OBJECT/view/VIEW`, the header names the object, with the sidebar expanded or collapsed. A test pins both.
2. A record route's crumb is unchanged (owned by #27524).
3. The split pane's narrowed list (#27545) does not draw a second crumb.

Refs #27594 · Related: #27524, #27545, #27593
